speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. To help me understand your condition, can you tell me how long these skin lesions have been present and if they are itchy or painful? Also, have you had any recent fevers, joint pain, or rashes elsewhere on your body?

speaker: Patient
text: 2-year-old female. The patient's mother reports noticing multiple painless, nonpruritic papules on the child's abdomen. The child attends daycare where another child was reported to have similar lesions recently. Patient's brother had chickenpox one month ago. Immunizations are up-to-date.

speaker: Doctor
text:
REQUEST TEST: Skin_Biopsy
The painless, non-itchy nature of the papules and the daycare exposure suggest Molluscum contagiosum, but I need to rule out other viral exanthems.
